raw_user_prompt: Build a Project Adapter Layer at .agentic-pi/runtime/project_adapter.py that maps a project's structure into the harness. The adapter should: 1) Read a project directory and produce project_map.json listing files, imports, entry points, and test files. 2) Let the harness understand real projects (git repos, multi-file, dependencies). 3) Integrate with existing artifact linker and task graph. The design should use subprocess/git to inspect the project, parse Python imports, and produce structured output that the planner can consume.
done_criteria: Can scan a directory and produce project_map.json
